displayName: MACOS - SH - Device Configuration - D - Swift Dialog Onboarding - R26.6 - v3.1
description:
UPDATE 20-05-2026:
Every row in the SwiftDialog onboarding monitor now launches with an
animated wait spinner and an SF=arrow.down.circle 'queued for download'
placeholder icon, replacing the default question-mark glyph for apps
that aren't on disk yet. When each app is detected, the row blooms
into the real .app bundle icon alongside the green tick.

Failed/timed-out rows intentionally keep the placeholder + red error
indicator so 'this never arrived' reads correctly.



RELEASE Info: Displays an interactive Swift Dialog onboarding splash screen that monitors for application installations in real-time. Waits for desktop and Swift Dialog binary availability, then detects Company Portal, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Edge, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Windows App via app bundle presence or package receipt. Does NOT install apps - only monitors and displays progress as apps are installed by other deployment mechanisms (e.g., Intune). Includes configurable timeouts for desktop wait (15 min), Dialog binary wait (20 min), and app monitoring (60 min).
